derivation: alpha=pi/12; u0=0.70; delta=0.01. The lower inner vertex has seam coordinates x0=u0/cos(alpha)-delta*tan(alpha), y0=delta.
The BT inner-leg clearance box starts at x_guard=4.60-0.50/2-0.05=4.30m and reaches |y|=0.60/2+0.05=0.35m. Choose y_guard=0.35+0.01=0.36m.
m=(y_guard-delta)/(x_guard-x0); b=delta-m*x0. Each side then has at least10mm extra tangent separation throughout the inflated BT box.
